objective: Set up the necessary cloud infrastructure and deployment processes for the system.
architecture: This package builds out the AWS infrastructure needed to support lower-level services like RDS, S3, and SQS, alongside deployment mechanisms using ECS Fargate for hosting.

tech_stack.rationale: Fargate's serverless containers eliminate EC2 patching, scales with API Gateway requests and SQS queue depth. Rejected EKS due to complexity; Lambda rejected due to long-running SAP sync jobs. Limitation: Cold starts may affect initial supervisor login, warm pool needed.

PostgreSQL's JSONB supports flexible metadata, referential integrity ensures proper workflow state transitions. Rejected DynamoDB because relational joins for supervisor dashboards are complex. Limitation: Multi-AZ RDS latency acceptable but adds overhead to frequent status updates.

S3's durability guarantees compressed photo preservation, KMS encryption meets internal data policy. Rejected EFS due to complexity with mobile uploads. Limitation: Requires lifecycle policy for compressed photo volume.

SQS provides reliable async processing for SAP validation of offline submissions, decouples submission from SAP availability. Rejected Redis because SQS integrates better with Spring Cloud AWS; Kafka considered but overkill for 200 daily transactions. Limitation: SQS standard queue doesn't guarantee order, but write-off validation order isn't critical.
